SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date) c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim USING (d_date_sk)
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1190
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer
        WHERE customer.c_customer_sk = store_sales.ss_customer_sk
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date) c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim USING (d_date_sk)
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1190
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer
        WHERE customer.c_customer_sk = catalog_sales.cs_bill_customer_sk
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date) c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim USING (d_date_sk)
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1190
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM customer
        WHERE customer.c_customer_sk = web_sales.ws_bill_customer_sk
      )
) hot_cust
LIMIT 100
